tier1_1_5_exposure_and_ruin.lesson: A waterworks distributor surfaced on the AI-power-and-grid screen; the revenue is water and wastewater infrastructure, zero data-center power. We do not buy a label.

A counter-drone 'play' whose entire exposure was a 19.99% minority stake in an early-stage company merely licensing technology: no funded program, no firm order, no defense revenue. Peripheral exposure to a hot force is still a pass.
Our survival firewall fired on confirmed evidence; we do not deploy into a going-concern balance sheet however attractive the story.

tier2_deep_dive_gate.lesson: A genuine counter-drone pure-play in our strongest force, but the load-bearing evidence ran backwards: the order book declined every quarter since it came public. Converting a shrinking book is the classic round-tripper signature.

A real, converting business in the advanced-cells force; the four-fold reward had already been consumed by a prior seven-to-eight-fold run. A great company at a price that no longer offers the geometry we require.

Five names we deliberately reinstated for a second look, on the chance the deep-dive gate had been too quick. The gate held on current data: four capped near two times, one tripped the survival firewall. The recall net gave them their fair hearing; the precision gate refused them.

tier4_near_miss.thesis_from_3c: The only one-year implantable glucose monitor reclaimed its own commercial channel, stepping gross margin to 59 percent, and is taking share in a 15-billion-dollar market locked at 98 percent by two incumbents.
tier4_near_miss.why_not: It completed a full deep due diligence and earned a constructive read, but against our sharpened opportunity bar it came up short: only the margin step is shown today, the load-bearing growth leg is asserted not demonstrated, and the evidence-backed reward is roughly two times with the larger payoff confined to a low-probability tail. A sound idea at the wrong moment. We hold cash and let it re-enter on a future scan if the next quarter converts the growth leg from claim to disclosed numbers.

regime_stance: Risk-on but more selective than a month ago. The policy-easing turn slipped toward hawkish on a hot jobs report, yet financing stayed abundant and the small-cap rotation bent rather than broke. Capital-backed bottleneck forces (defense, power, nuclear fuel, materials) carry a tailwind; the most fragile, cash-consuming balance sheets carry a marginal headwind.
